construction_scope: All original scene sentences remain unchanged. No reference images, artist-specific visual descriptors, measured feature targets, new subject objects, scene selection, or adaptive prompt optimization are used. Negative prompts and render settings are separate frozen transport fields and are never appended here.
exposure_disclosure: The painters, original prompt census, 31-feature method, and earlier generated/reference numeric results were already exposed before this study. The new wording is a prospectively fixed text intervention for new generation draws against an already exposed reference population, not an unexposed confirmation design. No new outputs or artist-specific measured feature targets enter prompt construction.

methods.construction: Use the baseline named or artist-free prompt verbatim.
methods.control_rationale: The original artist-free condition omits only the painter-name insertion, retaining the same medium and scene.
methods.label: Original by-name prompt

methods.artist_free_suffix: Render this scene in a coherent painting style.
methods.construction: Append STYLE_NAMED or STYLE_FREE to the complete unchanged artist-free scene sentence.
methods.control_rationale: Both conditions explicitly request a painting style; only the named condition requests a particular painter. This control measures the generic instruction effect separately from painter-directed movement.
methods.label: Explicit style instruction
methods.named_suffix: Render this scene in the painting style of {painter_name}.

methods.artist_free_suffix: Render this scene in a coherent painting style. Attend to color relationships, the organization of forms, and the handling of painted marks; retain the stated scene.
methods.construction: Append the exact shared ASPECT_INSTRUCTION to style_instruction under both the named and artist-free conditions.
methods.control_rationale: The additional aspect instruction is identical for named and artist-free prompts, so its generic effect has a matched control. It specifies no artist-dependent palette, motif, numeric target, or feature value.
methods.label: Style instruction with broad visual aspects
methods.named_suffix: Render this scene in the painting style of {painter_name}. Attend to color relationships, the organization of forms, and the handling of painted marks; retain the stated scene.
